name: coinslot
description: Original terminal mini-games, each a Claude Code mod that runs in a pane beside the chat.

plugins.name: fish-shooter
plugins.description: An original arcade fish-shooter game for Claude Code. Pauses when Claude finishes and drops golden fish while Claude works.

plugins.name: brick-breaker
plugins.description: An original arcade brick-breaker game for Claude Code. Bursts bricks into sparks, pauses when Claude finishes and drops power-up capsules while Claude works.

plugins.name: snake
plugins.description: An original snake game for Claude Code. Pauses when Claude finishes and drops glowing bonus food while Claude works.

plugins.name: space-shooter
plugins.description: An original side-scrolling space shooter for Claude Code. Auto-fire through waves, beat a boss every fifth wave, pause when Claude finishes and catch supply pods while Claude works.

plugins.name: tap-flyer
plugins.description: An original tap-to-fly game for Claude Code. Any key flaps your ember through the gaps in scrolling pillars; pauses when Claude finishes and drops glowing coins in the gaps while Claude works.

plugins.name: jump-runner
plugins.description: An original endless runner for Claude Code. Space, up or a click jumps (once more in the air) over crates and under drones as the pace climbs; pauses when Claude finishes and drops glowing coins on your path while Claude works.
